description: This file defines the LeaveComment entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing comments associated with leave requests, including properties like creator, timestamp, and comment text, mapped via Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: LeaveComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a comment on a leave request, including properties for comment text, associated leave, creator, and creation timestamp, with ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the LeaveComment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the LeaveComment.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Associates this comment with a specific Leave entity.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Gets the timestamp when the comment was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp for the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the User who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who created the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Gets the Employee details of the creator if applicable.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee details of the creator.
